body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> (Picture: 10.6-inch tablet notebook ''Xnote C1'' demoed at CES 2007)

LG Electronics is introducing a series of its nine laptops designed to support Windows Vista ranging from 10.6-inch to 17.1-inch in terms of screen size. They are available between 1,000,000(KRW) and 2,990,000(KRW).
